node.title: M31 line-profile compiler and semantic owner regression
node.closure: exact finite-field replay plus independent Lean build
node.statement: For the auxiliary deployed Mersenne-31 list row, theorem-certified duplicate-free near-rational and primitive one-pencil line-local slope lists of sizes at most 1 and floor(2097152/981129)=2 compile to paid profiles with slope denominator p, natural denominator p^67447, and calibrated natural numerator 1993679. Separately, one explicit received line over the order-twenty subgroup of F_241 has eleven genuine distinct-slope degree-<8 explanation states; two exact common-GCD pencil endpoints are chronology-valid earlier owners, and deleting them leaves an eight-neighbor residual satisfying 241^2(8-3)<=7 binom(10,6)^2 with margin 18295. The deployed constructors consume supplied certified lists: no exhaustive C1-C8 owner atlas, universal deployed residual theorem, aggregate payment, or Prize row is claimed.
